edit.title: Edit
archive.confirm: Archive {route} and its {n} child session(s)? They stop and move to _archive in the workspace; nothing is deleted.
archive.busy: A session is working. Stop it anyway and archive?
wiz.title: New root session
wiz.mission: Mission — what is this session for?
wiz.missionPh: e.g. watch the inbox, draft replies for my approval, escalate anything ambiguous
form.mcpHint: MCP servers this session may use. Servers defined by the folder itself are always on; checking one that is off in omp config enables it here.
form.mcpManual: This session's MCP profile is managed by hand. Changing a box here takes it over.
form.skillsHint: Everything is on by default; uncheck to exclude a skill from this session only (omp's own and the folder's skills included).
form.nameRule: a-z, 0-9 and -; 2-32 characters, starting with a letter
tools.stopSubtree: Stop this session and its children (graceful)
tools.killSubtree: Force-kill this session and its children
tree.stopConfirm: Stop {route} and its {n} child session(s)? Children stop first, then the parent; omp is given time to save.
tree.killConfirm: Force-kill {route} and its {n} child session(s)? Only for stuck sessions: they are stopped immediately.
wiz.folderHint: The session runs in this folder and the workspace keeps a link: move or archive the link, the folder stays put.
wiz.convNone: No earlier conversations in this folder.
wiz.isSession: This folder is already a session.
wiz.needFolder: Choose an existing folder that is not already a session.
wiz.folderUsedBy: This folder is already used by {route}.
wiz.resumeNote: Its conversation, model and tools come from the recipe stored in the folder. Step 2 shows them; change what you need.
wiz.warn.conversation-live: The conversation is open in another omp process: close it before resuming
wiz.warn.conversation-missing: The conversation file is gone: a new conversation will start
wiz.warn.model-unavailable: Its model {model} is not available: pick another in step 2
wiz.warn.desired-running: It was running when it lost its link: it may have stopped uncleanly
wiz.warn.mcp-owned: orch will rewrite its MCP entries in .omp/mcp.json
edit.name: Name
edit.restartHint: Saved changes apply after a restart.
files.title: Files
files.hint: Agents put deliverables in ./outbox/. Click a file to open it in a new tab.
edit.liveHint: Applies at once, no restart needed.
edit.folderHint: Where this session runs. Changing it parks the session, moves its files and starts it again.
edit.folderConfirmWs: Move {route} back into the workspace? The project folder loses its .orch folder.
edit.folderLeft: Folder changed. Left behind in the old workspace folder: {names}
edit.convKeepNote: Resume the same chat in the new folder
edit.convNewNote: Fresh chat; the old one stays in omp history
edit.approveHint: One tool-name pattern per line. * matches any characters, case does not matter. A matching call waits in the inbox for your decision. Examples: mcp__*send*, write, bash.
edit.autoHint: Wake this session on a timetable or from a webhook. Both travel with the session folder.
edit.envHint: Which variables the session process sees. Applies after a restart.
edit.env.allNote: All variables of the server process
edit.env.minimalNote: Only PATH, HOME, locale and the secrets below
edit.envNoSecrets: No secrets stored yet. Add some with the key button in the sidebar.
edit.envNotStored: not stored: taken from the server environment
auto.cron: Cron: minute hour day month weekday
auto.textPh: What the agent should do each time this fires
auto.name: Trigger name
auto.templateHint: {body} is replaced by the request body of the call.
auto.errSchedule: Every schedule needs a valid cron expression and a message.
auto.errTrigger: Every trigger needs a name and a message template.
form.toolsHint: Built-in tools this session may use. MCP and peer tools are never limited here. Everything checked means no limit.
form.toolRisk: can change files or run code
wiz.roleHint: A role prefills the mission, model, MCP and tools, and adds approvals and schedules. Everything stays editable.
secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.hint: Values are stored on this machine and never shown again. A session receives a secret only when its Environment lists it.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.badName: Capital letters, digits and _; not starting with a digit
secrets.replaceHint: Saving an existing name replaces its value. Click a name to replace it.
archive.title: Archive
archive.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete the archived session "{route}" and every file in its folder? This cannot be undone. Conversations stay in omp and a linked project folder is not touched.
